extDescription.message: See who is waiting for an answer without keeping the board open. Reads only what a wall screen shows.

boardAddressHint.message: The address IT gave you, for example https://board.company.com. The browser will ask to allow this one site only.

pairingHint.message: Give this code to an admin. They enter it in Admin > TV screens and approve it. No password is needed here.

notifyOn.message: Notify me when someone waits too long

forgetConfirm.message: Unpair this browser? You will need a new code approved by an admin to pair again.

notPaired.message: This browser is not paired with the board yet.

revoked.message: This browser is no longer paired: an admin revoked it or it expired. Get a new code to pair again.

codeExpired.message: The code expired before it was approved. Get a new code.

pairingUnreachable.message: Cannot reach the board right now; still trying.

needPermission.message: The browser no longer allows this extension to reach the board.

unreachable.message: Cannot reach the board. You may be outside the company network, or the server is down. No numbers are shown until it answers again.

invalidAddress.message: This is not a web address. Example: https://board.company.com

httpNotAllowed.message: Plain http works only for this computer (localhost or 127.0.0.1). Use the board's https address, for example https://board.company.com

permissionDenied.message: The browser did not allow access to this address, so the extension cannot pair.

tooManyWaiting.message: Too many devices are waiting for approval. Try again later.

cannotReach.message: Cannot reach the board at this address. Check the address and that you are on the company network.

badgeUnreachable.message: AI Worker: cannot reach the board

notifyTitle.message: Someone is waiting for a reply
